title: Update 19.2 for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central 2021 Release Wave 2
summary: Update 19.2 for Business Central 2021 Release Wave 2 introduces two-dimensional barcodes in reports, AL compiler diagnostic URLs, and multiline text field synchronization with Dataverse. It includes localization updates for Intrastat requirements, Mexico Carta de Porte 2.0, and Norway VAT Return submission.
features: AL compiler diagnostic messages with URLs
multiline text field synchronization with Dataverse
